name: reactnative-lightening-wallet-rs
description: High-performance unified Lightning wallet for React Native

scripts.build:android: cd rust && cargo ndk -t x86_64 -o ../android/src/main/jniLibs build --release
scripts.build:android:all: cd rust && cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -t armeabi-v7a -t x86_64 -t x86 -o ../android/src/main/jniLibs build --release
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:android:all && npm run build:ios
scripts.clean: rm -rf android/build ios/build ios/lib ios/LighteningWallet.xcframework rust/target js/*.js js/*.d.ts

author: Element FM
